hero.title: See where public money goes—and the evidence behind it.
hero.description: Explore local budgets, follow projects from allocation to payment, and ask clear questions in English, Nepali, or Romanized Nepali.
hero.safety: Budget Darpan does not accuse. It identifies patterns and evidence that may require further review.

visual.label: Illustration of the Budget Darpan evidence trail
visual.title: From promise to public evidence

allocation.title: Budget allocation
allocation.description: Exact amounts come from structured, traceable records.

project.title: Project and contract
project.description: Available procurement records stay connected; missing records remain visible as evidence gaps.

payment.title: Payment and progress
payment.description: Reported spending is shown separately from unknown data.

evidence.title: Documents and citizen evidence
evidence.description: Every narrative claim can lead back to its source.

journey.title: A single story instead of disconnected spreadsheets.
journey.description: Budget Darpan connects allocations, projects, procurement, payments, official progress, documents, and verified citizen feedback so a citizen can understand the full context without becoming a financial analyst.

principles.title: Built for questions that deserve careful answers.

numbers.title: Numbers from the database
numbers.description: Financial totals use relational records and decimal arithmetic. The AI never invents or calculates official values.

citations.title: Claims linked to sources
citations.description: Document answers preserve title, page, section, fiscal year, municipality, and source link whenever available.

anomalies.title: Patterns, not accusations
anomalies.description: Every indicator explains the rule, threshold, data used, possible explanations, and recommended next step.

project.errorTitle: The project record could not be loaded.
project.errorDescription: Start the local API and try again. Public browsing remains available when optional AI services are offline.
project.notReported: No payment data has been reported for this project.
project.procurementNotReported: No procurement notice has been found for this project.
project.awardNotReported: No contract award has been found for this project.
project.moneyTrailDescription: Each step stays linked to the same project so amounts, dates, contractor details, payments, and milestones can be checked in context.
project.chartEmpty: No comparable allocation, contract, or payment values have been reported.
project.mapDescription: A marker appears only when a source-backed project location is available. Missing coordinates never block the evidence trail.
project.mapUnavailable: No coordinates have been reported for this project.

paymentStatus.not_yet_reported: Payment information is not yet reported

project.milestonesUnknown: No official milestone or physical-progress record has been found yet.

evidence.title: Source documents and citations
evidence.description: Project evidence is linked deliberately by claim type, page, section, and official source. A municipal document is never treated as proof of an unrelated project figure.
evidence.syntheticBoundary: This project contains synthetic demo figures. Official municipal documents may provide context, but they are not proof of those synthetic amounts.
evidence.error: Linked evidence is temporarily unavailable. The project money trail remains accessible.
evidence.empty: No source document has been linked to this project yet.

documents.title: Government documents with page-level traceability
documents.description: Each original PDF is preserved, hashed, extracted page by page, and marked for review when OCR or text quality is uncertain.
documents.error: The source library could not be loaded.
documents.detailError: This source document could not be loaded.
documents.empty: No source documents are registered yet. Run the evidence ingestion command after seeding the database.
documents.landingPageWarning: The manifest currently records an official listing page; the exact attachment URL still requires verification.
documents.fileUnavailable: The preserved local PDF is not available in this environment.
documents.pagePending: This page has not been extracted or accepted yet.
